title: From Exploration to Mastery: Enabling LLMs to Master Tools via Self-Driven Interactions

layout.note: Three panels in an L-shaped grid: (a) on the left spanning the full height, with a page stack at the far left and four rows of excerpt, robot question or error line at its right; (b) top right on a cyan ground with three cycles of robots and icons separated by block arrows; (c) bottom right on a lilac ground with logos, the judge's speech box and stacked win/tie/lose bars. Letters sit at the bottom of each panel; there are no panel titles.

lesson: Tell a problem, a process and a result in one figure: red dashed boxes on a page stack tied by arrows to enlarged excerpts and their errors, the same icon cycle repeated per round while a grid of eyes flips from crossed-out to open, and one stacked bar chart as the verdict.
